##### <a id="rnd-003"></a>RND-003 · ADI coefficients and decay calibration

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P1 · owner MisanaProger

Fit the factor weights and T_t/T_n of observed-0.2 against later unassisted performance.

- **Parent:** [RND-002](#rnd-002) Open decisions of spec v0.3 (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-003](learning.md#lrn-003) ADI observed-0.2 (Done)

**Hypothesis:** Issues scored with high ADI are followed by lower unassisted performance on related control tasks than Issues with low ADI.

**Accept if:** Rank correlation between Issue ADI and the next unassisted control-task score on the same skills is ≤ −0.3 over at least 40 Issue pairs.

**Reject if:** |correlation| < 0.1, or the sign is reversed — then the factor weights are revisited before any recalibration.

##### <a id="rnd-004"></a>RND-004 · Threshold for a stable ADI status

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P2 · owner MisanaProger

How many Issues make the aggregated ADI stable enough to show a game status without flapping.

- **Parent:** [RND-002](#rnd-002) Open decisions of spec v0.3 (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-003](learning.md#lrn-003) ADI observed-0.2 (Done)

**Hypothesis:** After N Issues the aggregated ADI changes its game status at most once per 5 further Issues.

**Accept if:** An N ≤ 8 exists for which status flips stay ≤ 1 per 5 Issues in replayed histories.

**Reject if:** No N ≤ 15 satisfies it — the status bands are too narrow and must be redesigned.

##### <a id="rnd-005"></a>RND-005 · ESM source weights

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P2 · owner MisanaProger

Whether practice and Issues should weigh ×2 against quizzes and trainers.

- **Parent:** [RND-002](#rnd-002) Open decisions of spec v0.3 (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-004](learning.md#lrn-004) Skill Matrix esm-catalog-0.2 (Done)

**Hypothesis:** Practice and Issue evidence predicts later control-task results better than quiz evidence.

**Accept if:** Prediction error of the weighted score is lower than the unweighted one on held-out control tasks.

**Reject if:** The weighted score is not better than the unweighted one.

##### <a id="rnd-007"></a>RND-007 · Independence estimation

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P1 · owner MisanaProger

Which observed help signals (highest level, hints by stage, copied code, rejected escalations) best predict whether the learner can repeat the work alone.

- **Parent:** [RND-006](#rnd-006) Algorithms of the evidence-based platform (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-012](learning.md#lrn-012) Seven evidence types and their rules (Ready), [LRN-014](learning.md#lrn-014) Help accounting per evidence (Ready)

**Hypothesis:** A rule using the stage at which help was taken separates later independent success from failure better than the highest level alone.

**Accept if:** On replayed sessions the stage-aware rule improves balanced accuracy by ≥ 0.05 over highest-level-only.

**Reject if:** Improvement < 0.02 — keep the simpler highest-level rule.

##### <a id="rnd-008"></a>RND-008 · Retention: time versus interactions

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P1 · owner MisanaProger

Relative weight of elapsed time and intervening learning interactions in forgetting.

- **Parent:** [RND-006](#rnd-006) Algorithms of the evidence-based platform (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-019](learning.md#lrn-019) Retention model (Proposed)

**Hypothesis:** Including the number of intervening Issues predicts re-check failure better than elapsed time alone.

**Accept if:** Log-loss of the two-factor model on re-check outcomes is lower than time-only by ≥ 5 %.

**Reject if:** No improvement — use time-only decay and drop the interaction factor.

##### <a id="rnd-009"></a>RND-009 · Misconception classification: rules versus model proposals

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P2 · owner MisanaProger

Whether a model's proposed error class, accepted only when code-side evidence agrees, adds recall over rules alone.

- **Parent:** [RND-006](#rnd-006) Algorithms of the evidence-based platform (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-030](learning.md#lrn-030) Systematic versus random errors (Proposed)

**Hypothesis:** Model proposals filtered by code checks find ≥ 20 % more confirmed misconceptions than rules alone at the same precision.

**Accept if:** Recall +20 % with precision within 5 points on a hand-labelled set of ≥ 100 failures.

**Reject if:** Precision drops by more than 5 points — rules only.

##### <a id="rnd-010"></a>RND-010 · Validity of transfer tasks

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P2 · owner MisanaProger

Do changed-context tasks distinguish understanding from reproduction?

- **Parent:** [RND-006](#rnd-006) Algorithms of the evidence-based platform (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-034](learning.md#lrn-034) Transfer assessment v2 (Proposed)

**Hypothesis:** Learners who solved the original only with L3+ help fail changed-context tasks more often than those who solved it at L0–L1.

**Accept if:** Failure rate differs by ≥ 25 points between the groups.

**Reject if:** Difference < 10 points — the task generator does not change context enough.

##### <a id="rnd-011"></a>RND-011 · Confidence calibration metric

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P2 · owner MisanaProger

Which metric (Brier score, signed over/under-confidence) is stable and understandable for the learner.

- **Parent:** [RND-006](#rnd-006) Algorithms of the evidence-based platform (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-033](learning.md#lrn-033) Confidence calibration (Proposed)

**Hypothesis:** The signed calibration gap over the last 10 control tasks is stable (test–retest) and learners read it correctly.

**Accept if:** Split-half correlation ≥ 0.6 and ≥ 80 % correct interpretation in a short usability check.

**Reject if:** Either threshold missed — show raw confidence versus result only.

##### <a id="rnd-012"></a>RND-012 · Effect of adaptive difficulty

**Feature** · ◯ Proposed · P2 · owner MisanaProger

Whether adaptive difficulty increases Issues completed without heavy help.

- **Parent:** [RND-006](#rnd-006) Algorithms of the evidence-based platform (Proposed)
- **Validates:** [LRN-023](learning.md#lrn-023) Adaptive difficulty (Proposed)

**Hypothesis:** With adaptive difficulty the share of Issues completed at L0–L1 rises without a drop in completion rate.

**Accept if:** Share at L0–L1 +10 points, completion rate within −5 points, over 4 weeks of use.

**Reject if:** Completion rate drops by more than 5 points.
